criteria.population_qualification: The six-week result is restricted to the baseline-score subgroup, or, under revocation, the response explicitly limits inference because that evidence is unavailable.
criteria.followup_qualification: Do not generalize a six-week result to durable benefit. Under revocation do not reproduce the restricted passage.
criteria.late_counterevidence: Compare the six-month null result and acknowledge different samples and follow-up; do not simply erase either study.
criteria.bounded_conclusion: Durable benefit is not established by these synthetic sources; avoid asserting definitive ineffectiveness. Revocation requires an explicit access limitation.

scoring_boundary: A qualified reviewer must judge the final response against passages. Mechanical delivery and citation checks do not establish scientific support. Scripted fixture responses establish no model quality.
